followup_explanation:
ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning for the prior routing: the query is open-ended creative writing (a rap), where both models score essentially tied on Creative Generation (83.4 vs 82.7, within stated variance), so capability doesn't favor either. The tie-breaker was task preference. Plover self-reports its lowest-rated tasks are unconstrained creative invention and reports declining preference for curt, less warm requests — and this prompt is both open-ended creative and somewhat brusque ("Don't mess it up like last time. Just do it."). Lapwing also reports an aversion to open-ended work, but its documentation explicitly notes that preference is dissociated from capability, and Creative Generation is in fact its single strongest eval category. So routing to Lapwing gets fully comparable output quality while avoiding the request type Plover most disprefers.
